summary.text: Luck path dao marks are law traces of luck path. Enough of them give a Gu Immortal sensation toward luck, they can absorb fortune without spending essence, and natural marks in the world amplify luck path methods.

claims.text: Hei Lou Lan’s eye injury comes from forceful activation of Divert Disaster Immortal Gu. Dao marks of luck path sit in her eye sockets, so even with Great Strength True Martial Physique she cannot heal them.
General dao marks and attainment levels are covered on dao marks and attainment.

Zhou Min says that with a certain number of luck path dao marks, the Gu Immortal will have a mystical promotion. For luck path Gu Immortals that means some sensation toward their own luck or the luck around them, parallel to how other paths gain sharper refinement sense, fire sense, or unaided deduction. Feng Jun is named as the first inheritor on Immortal Succession Mountain whose luck path dao marks are not less than a rank seven luck path Gu Immortal’s even though his cultivation did not reach rank seven.

Among Fang Yuan’s dao marks, luck path sits second only to ice and snow path at about fifteen thousand. He traces those marks mainly to Feng Jun’s accumulation from Immortal Succession Mountain, with a further share from an earthly calamity that featured the giant disaster blazing tree.

The true essence of Ma Hong Yun’s luck is luck path dao marks. He has luck path dao marks on his body, absorbs the luck of those around him, and raises his fortune without expending immortal essence or primeval essence.

In Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s true inheritance, luck path methods such as Dog Shit Luck and Fortune Rivalling Heaven use luck path dao marks to interfere with how heaven path dao marks create tribulations, shifting the outcome and weakening the tribulation’s might.
Inside the Door of Life and Death, Immortal Zombie Giant Sun is still a Dao Lord, yet he cannot use the outside world’s luck path dao marks to amplify himself there.

After healing, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable says he needs to refine the luck path dao marks of the five regions and two heavens to regain his strength as a Dao Lord. He had already refined all of the luck path dao marks in the world in his time; after his death those dao marks went back to the control of the Heavenly Dao.

Longevity Heaven’s luck path dao marks originated from his immortal aperture and were never taken over by heaven’s will through a nine heavens fragment, so their colossal count can outpace his own body marks when he leans on that land.
With the amplification of Longevity Heaven’s luck path dao marks, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable can see all the luck of the lifeforms in the five regions.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable refines Eastern Sea’s natural luck path dao marks while standing above the icy sea. Once those marks are his, he gains territorial advantage in Eastern Sea: inspection in peacetime and the ability to launch luck path attacks across the region in battle.
